channel.complex_packing: flattened tensor first half as real and second half as imaginary
channel.power_normalization: unit average complex power before channel

training_metadata.selection: highest mean per-image PSNR over Kodak and SNR 1,4,7,10,13; first best on ties
training_metadata.condition_sampling: one SNR per optimizer step, shared across accumulated microbatches
training_metadata.channel_normalization_scope: physical batch, not the effective accumulated batch

parent_run.selection_scope: first highest validation PSNR across epochs 1-400
